The '''''Sudden Death''''' was a modified [[MRX-BR Pacifier]] owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Iceman]]. He added an additional [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] and additional [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] space by converting the passenger quarters into a brig.
